_doc: Jackson Dr north (Lake Murray piece D): the road's two outer edges per station off the USGS 2024 lidar (jackson_curbs_g10.py; the method is its docstring). u = metres off D's line, + = left of D's travel along increasing s (J4 -> J5). left / right: verdict face / none / unclear; type curb, edge (rise) or edge (drop); face_u_m, unc_m (half the interval between the neighbouring points the face lies between), step_m (outer - road at the face; negative for a drop). built = D's own row (left_m, right_m; middle = their mean). real_middle_m = the mean of the two faces; real_minus_built_middle_m its difference. Settings marked [invented] in the script are the method's choices.

frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track.to_local: pyproj EPSG 6340 -> 4326 ('Inverse of UTM zone 11N + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)', stated accuracy 2.0 m), then the WGS84 metres-per-degree series at the origin

travel_bearing_deg.what: D's tangent along increasing s, degrees from north

road_at_line_minus_y3dep_m.what: the lidar road within 0.5 m of D's line (last returns, OUT_Q percentile, grade out) minus D's y_3dep, engine y
